suggestions: Add a distinct "Contact Information" section to ensure your resume passes ATS automated category parsers.
Substantiate your achievements with quantifiable results (e.g. "improved query performance by 25%" or "servicing 10k+ requests").
Expand your Technical Competencies section with core industry tools, libraries, and frameworks.
Format your project bullets using the STAR method: Start each line with strong verbs like Engineered, Optimized, or Deployed.

interviews.feedbackText: Great overall performance Trupti! Your React and database theory is very strong. Continue working on structuring your behavioral/project-based answers using action-oriented frameworks like STAR.
suggestions: Use the STAR framework for project-based questions.
Add more concrete metrics when explaining what you built (e.g., "achieved 15% improvement").
Slightly slow down your speaking pace to sound more composed and confident.
